description: Read the SCF reference catalog (no org): controls, one control with its objectives and evidence, domains, frameworks, assessment objectives, evidence definitions. Pick with method.

control_id.description: Limit to one SCF control in DOMAIN-NN format (e.g., 'GOV-01', 'AST-02') Used by: list_assessment_objectives.

domain.description: SCF domain code (e.g., 'GOV', 'AST', 'IAC') — obtain from scf_list_domains Used by: list_controls.

evidence_id.description: Catalog evidence ID, e.g. E-IAM-01 — obtain from scf_list_evidence_catalog Used by: get_evidence.

framework.description: Framework slug (e.g., 'nist-800-53', 'iso-27001') — obtain from scf_list_frameworks Used by: list_controls.

identifier.description: Domain code or slug, e.g. 'IAC' — obtain from scf_list_domains Used by: get_domain.

include_deprecated.description: Include catalog rows deprecated by a later SCF version. Default false — the catalog answers with active rows only, and deprecated rows carry a lifecycle badge when included. [list_controls, list_domains, list_assessment_objectives, list_evidence] | Include deprecated controls (default false) [get_domain] Used by: list_controls, list_domains, get_domain, list_assessment_objectives, list_evidence.

limit.description: Page size (1–100, default 25) Used by: list_controls, list_assessment_objectives, list_evidence.

method.description:
list_controls: List SCF security controls from the reference catalog. Returns paginated controls with SCF ID, title, description, and mapped frameworks. Filter by domain, framework, or free-text search.
get_control: Get a single SCF control by ID. Returns description, mapped frameworks, assessment objectives, and linked evidence items from the reference catalog.
list_domains: List every compliance domain in the SCF taxonomy. Domains group related controls (e.g., GOV = Governance, AST = Asset Management, IAC = Identity & Access Control).
get_domain: Get one SCF domain with its controls (read, no org). Deprecated controls are excluded unless include_deprecated is set; a deprecated domain still resolves, badged.
list_frameworks: List every compliance framework mapped in the SCF catalog (NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2, FedRAMP, GDPR, and 350+ more). Returns framework identifiers and display names.
list_assessment_objectives: List SCF assessment objectives — the 5,736 test criteria used to evaluate control implementation. Optionally filter by control ID; supports free-text search and pagination.
list_evidence: List the SCF reference catalog's 272 evidence types (read, no org). control_mappings is the catalogue-wide mapping, not scope — see scf_get_evidence_requiring_controls. Free-text search, pagination.
get_evidence: Get one catalog evidence entry (read, no org): title, description, area of focus, control_mappings — the catalogue-wide mapping, not scope. In-scope requirers: scf_get_evidence_requiring_controls.

offset.description: Pagination offset — number of results to skip (default 0) Used by: list_controls, list_assessment_objectives, list_evidence.

scf_id.description: SCF control identifier in DOMAIN-NN format (e.g., 'AST-01', 'IAC-15', 'GOV-02') Used by: get_control.

search.description: Free-text filter applied to control title and description [list_controls] | Free-text filter applied to objective text [list_assessment_objectives] | Free-text filter applied to evidence title and description [list_evidence] Used by: list_controls, list_assessment_objectives, list_evidence.

name: scf_catalog_read
